issue.title: PluginsRequired version-mismatch install closes without updating the plugin
issue.description: The PluginsRequired command passes each roster name to plan_install. plan_install returns AlreadyInstalled for any matching receipt row without evaluating the required version, and _execute_install then emits a successful result without changing that row. A version_mismatch gate can therefore close while its declared requirement remains unsatisfied. Found while landing sase-to; this behavior predates the definitive-PyPI-fallback commit and is not caused by that epic.

task_type_fields.impact: Projects with an installed but incompatible required plugin can have their blocking gate dismissed as successfully handled while agents continue under the wrong plugin version.
task_type_fields.repro: Create a PluginsRequired roster entry with kind version_mismatch for a plugin already present at an out-of-range version, then answer Install. plan_install returns AlreadyInstalled based only on the normalized distribution name, _execute_install records it as installed, and the command exits 0 without running uv or satisfying the requirement.
